name: Pig Catcher
summary: Replaced flat radiator plates and rear leaves with convex panels and explicit crests. Raised both round spotlights above the beak instead of hiding them behind it. Split the engine into a smaller crankcase, tapered cylinder and real cooling ribs; tapered trousers with overlapping knee joints, connected the neck, added shirt collar/placket/pockets. Replaced bar spokes with narrow open wires and removed buried tread faces. Baked triangles 2595 / 898 / 599; unchanged physics/sidecar. Global silhouette scores 0.8451 / 0.8226 / 0.7978 remain below ~.95; review candidate with remaining shaded mismatches documented. Coarse tyres now retain twelve outer stations and eight vertices around the open rim hole. Hidden joined caps, buried panel backs and fender undersides funded the round silhouette without changing LOD0.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.
